comment_regular: Verified player-scaled lock level calculation. This reads ExtraLockData.level as a signed byte; when flags bit 0x04 is set it adds PlayerCharacter::GetLevel() multiplied by GameSettingFloat fLeveledLockMult and clamps to 99. Fallout's REFR_LOCK::GetLevel accepts an owner reference and uses that reference's calculated level when non-null; Oblivion always uses global PlayerCharacter reference. This is a direct implementation divergence.
